entities.name: Sauruven Hellwald
entities.description: Black Knight of the Schwartzenritterein order, servant of the planeswalker Thomil.

entities.name: Eumenes
entities.description: Mourning Hurloon Minotaur whom Sauruven befriended and later killed.

entities.name: Eurynomous
entities.description: Eumenes' mate, killed by a Stone Giant.

entities.name: Stone Giant
entities.description: Giant that killed Eurynomous; killed by Sauruven.

entities.name: Gurdurngs
entities.description: Dominarian location where Sauruven met Eumenes.

events.summary: Sauruven meets the mourning minotaur Eumenes in the Gurdurngs and helps with the lamentation ritual.
events.quote: Saruven met the mourning Hurloon Minotaur Eumenes

events.summary: Thomil summons Sauruven to a duel against Eumenes, summoned by the opposing planeswalker; Sauruven kills him.
Sauruven kills the Stone Giant that killed Eurynomous.
events.quote: went and killed the Stone Giant

relations.quote: His master was the planeswalker Thomil
a Black Knight of the Schwartzenritterein order
